facts.note: Nine o'clock bell at dinner, watches shown: narrator's exact, Félix 20 min behind, Girard 4 min behind, doctor 2 min ahead.
After dinner worked beside the master in the atelier; at the temple's ten, the regulator agreed with the bell exactly.
Sent downstairs when the regulator showed twenty past ten; regulator was running and the master was well.
In the kitchen compared her watch with Rosa's clock; Rosa's clock was exactly fifteen minutes fast.
Piano heard beginning at 10:48 and stopping at 11:01, both by the kitchen clock.
Went straight down to the kitchen and stayed with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
